items.title: Joe Harris Interview, 1961-04-12
items.q: Was Eddie Jackson playing with him?

ctx.x: Yeah, record. Yeah, recording funds, you call it.
Yeah, hold on. Do you remember some of the old fellas was playing with Old Man Allen when you played the funeral or whatever? Was Eddie Jackson playing with him? No. You don't remember that.
Uh-uh. I'm going to tell you the facts. I can't call back that for a man. The guy that's playing in the parade there.
